name: CX7
tagline: Iconic suspended fireplace delivering 360-degree architectural warmth
dimensions: Fully customizable to fit ceiling height
description: The CX7 is a masterpiece of modern luxury heating, featuring an iconic suspended design that floats effortlessly to create a spectacular focal point. Crafted from premium heavy-duty steel plate, this avant-garde fireplace is engineered for open-concept residential spaces, boutique hospitality venues, and upscale commercial lounges. Its elegant, organic contours and open-fire design provide uncompromised radiant warmth and an unobstructed view of the dancing flames, blending sculptural artistry with high-performance thermal comfort.
features: Dramatic ceiling-mounted suspended profile maximizing floor space and luxury appeal
Premium heavy-duty steel plate construction built for high temperature resistance
Fully customizable pipe length tailored precisely to your specific room and ceiling height
Substantial heating capacity engineered to efficiently warm large, open-concept areas
Versatile architectural layout ideally suited for luxury villas, sunrooms, and boutique cafes
